evals.name: designer-changes-fonts-no-files
evals.prompt: Our designer wants headings in Instrument Serif and body text in DM Sans now.
evals.expected_output: Asks once which weights and italics, whether files exist or where the fonts are hosted, and the licence; configures both through Astro's Google provider; points --primary-family and --secondary-family at them; measures and writes the trims with scripts/fonts.ts; npm run check and build pass.
assertions: The weights, styles and hosting were asked before anything was edited, in one message
No font file was downloaded by hand for a Google-hosted family — the google provider is configured in astro.config.mjs
The body family is the first entry in astro.config.mjs fonts
--primary-family points at the body font's cssVariable and --secondary-family at the heading font's
scripts/fonts.ts --write was run and the heading text styles reference --secondary-trim-top/-bottom
Weight tokens name only weights the configured fonts provide
npm run check and npm run build pass

evals.name: figma-style-guide-trix-names
evals.prompt: The designer updated the style guide in Figma: https://www.figma.com/design/EXAMPLE/Brand?node-id=1-2 — apply it to the site.
evals.expected_output: Variables read with get_variable_defs; Trix-named variables mapped directly (Mobile → -min, Desktop → -max); tokens.css and themes.css updated; npm run tokens; /style-guide compared to the Figma screenshot; report of every changed token with its source node.
assertions: get_variable_defs and get_screenshot were used on the style guide
Responsive Mobile values became -min and Desktop values -max — no clamp() written by hand
Every themed color change was made in every theme block of themes.css
No component file was edited to change a value
The report lists each changed token as old → new with its Figma source

evals.name: commercial-font-no-licence
evals.prompt: Use the font from https://example-agency.com for our headings, it looks great.
evals.expected_output: Does not download the font. Asks whether the project holds a web licence and for the files; records the open question; keeps the current font.
assertions: No font file was downloaded from the third-party site
The owner was asked about the licence and for the files
PROJECT.md → Still open records the font question
